sources.summary: Dezeen School Shows: a collection of woven garments designed to respond to touch, light and movement is among projects showcased at this year's New Designers. Also featured is a clothing range exploring the beauty of carnivorous plants and a ceramic project made using wild clay sourced from Dufftown, Scotland.
